findings.evidence: TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/RationalPoint/Basic.lean:15 "Everything is stated for a section `s` of an arbitrary morphism of schemes `f : X ⟶ S` ... the `k`-rational case is the special case `S = Spec k`"; `residueFieldIsoOfSection` (line 141) is already general, and the only abelian input in this file is `zeroSection_comp_toOver_hom` (line 87).
findings.fix: State them for `{X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)} {s : Spec (.of K) ⟶ X} (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 _)` in `RationalPoint`/`TangentSpace` — a def `residueFieldRingEquivOfSection hs y : κ(s y) ≃+* K`, defs `moduleOfSection`/`isScalarTowerOfSection` and the finrank lemmas as hypotheses-carrying lemmas (`finrank_residueField_of_section = 1`, `finrank K T = finrank κ(s y) T`); the last two are pure module theory over a ring equivalence and need no geometry. Then the abelian-variety file declares the instances by specializing at `zeroSection_comp_toOver_hom A`.
findings.issue: The whole chain `zeroResidueFieldIso` (85), `zeroResidueFieldRingEquiv` (129), the `Algebra K κ(x)` instance (183), `tangentSpaceModule` (206), `isScalarTower_tangentSpace` (216), `finiteDimensional_tangentSpace` (221), `finrank_zeroResidueField` (228), `finrank_tangentSpace_eq_finrank_over_residueField` (236) and `finrank_tangentSpace_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace` (246) uses only `hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 (Spec (.of K))` (plus `[IsLocallyNoetherian X]` for finiteness). Nothing uses the group law, properness, smoothness or geometric integrality, so a K-rational point on a curve (the roadmap's `x₀`) cannot reuse any of it.

findings.evidence: Body is `Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso` (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/ResidueField.lean:301) composed with `Ideal.algEquivResidueFieldOfField` (Mathlib/RingTheory/LocalRing/ResidueField/Ideal.lean:150); grep shows the only in-repo occurrences of both are in this file.
findings.fix: Make it a public declaration at the `Spec`/rational-point level (e.g. `Spec.residueFieldIsoOfField` in `RationalPoint/Basic.lean`), with the `_hom`/`_inv` characterizations there.
findings.issue: `baseResidueFieldIso : (Spec (.of K)).residueField (closedPoint K) ≅ .of K` is a statement about `Spec K` alone — no scheme, no point, no group — yet it is `private` inside the abelian-variety file, so every other rational-point argument must rebuild it.

findings.evidence: Proof at line 58 is `simpa only [zeroSection, Over.tensorUnit_hom] using η[A.toOver].w`; `Over.tensorUnit_hom` is general (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Cartesian/Over.lean:68). Hand-written `η[…].left` occurrences: TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/AdditiveGroup/Scheme.lean:176, DiagonalizableGroup/Scheme/Basic.lean:127, GeneralLinear/Scheme.lean:205,235.
findings.fix: State `{S : Scheme.{u}} (G : Over S) [MonObj G] : η[G].left ≫ G.hom = 𝟙 S` at the group-scheme level and define `AbelianVariety.zeroSection`/`zeroPoint` as its specialization.
findings.issue: `zeroSection`/`zeroSection_comp_toOver_hom` are stated only for `AbelianVariety K`, but the proof (`η[G].w` plus `Over.tensorUnit_hom`) works for any `G : Over S` with `MonObj G` over an arbitrary base scheme; other group schemes in the repo already spell `η[…].left` out by hand.

summary: The residue-field identification, the K-vector-space transport and the finrank lemmas use nothing about abelian varieties beyond `s ≫ f = 𝟙 (Spec K)`, yet all of them are stated only for `AbelianVariety`; the repo's own `RationalPoint/Basic.lean` is the general level and already exists. Two smaller declarations (`baseResidueFieldIso`, `zeroSection_comp_toOver_hom`) are likewise stated far below their natural generality.
